reference.kind: stand-in: Boss's prevalence targets for the life class system (docs/design/habitability/life-classes.md 5.2, 9:13 PM EDT 2026-10-28), tier T9, tweak level L3; set from Boss's rule that sentient life is the rarest and from Core 1's timing review (complex cells 2.5, animals 3, civilization 60 Gyr, scale 1.0), not from observation
reference.worlds: stops_before_animals and two_or_more_classes: every terrestrial planet and moon with a life chemistry in whole seeded systems, with the default configuration. The other three measures: the oxygenic ones among them, in systems made around G2V and K5V (GEN.907, Boss 6:04 AM EDT 10-29: the bands are per oxygenic world, Core 1's figures describe oxygenic life)

stops_before_animals.source: the majority (more than half) of life worlds stop at origin, producers or complex cells

reaches_animals.source: about 15 to 35 percent of oxygenic life worlds reach animals (any grade), Core 1's figures of 21 to 33 per 100 for oxygenic life

reaches_sentient.source: no more than 1 to 2 percent of oxygenic life worlds are sentient (Boss: rarest)

sentient_of_animal_worlds.source: always fewer than one in twenty of the worlds that have animals are sentient (animals to civilizations 20 to 40 to 1)

two_or_more_classes.source: GEN.1209 (several life classes on one body): measured 0.857 of 727 life worlds on 400 default systems at epoch 131 (the dominant class 3a or 4b with the other beside it); the band is that measurement widened to guard against the list collapsing to one class or a class being lost, not a researched target (registry row LC1, tier T9, tweak level L3)

any_trait.source: TEST.436, GEN.876: measured about 0.06 of 78 life worlds in 40 default systems when the traits were built (5 with a trait); the band guards against the draw going silent or every life world carrying one, not a researched target (registry rows LF66 to LF69)

extreme_of_traits.source: TEST.436, GEN.876: the extreme grade is drawn with a chance of half the stress score squared, so most traits are tolerant; the band guards against every trait being extreme (registry row LF68)
